_instructions: Matters that match any entry below are flagged in the 'Watchlist Match' column,
on the Dashboard, and trigger a separate 'ACCC watchlist alert' email when they
are new, change, or receive a new decision document.
companies:    names matched as whole words against the matter name and all parties, e.g. "Coles", "Woolworths"
sectors:      M&A sector labels exactly as shown in the 'M&A Sector' column, e.g. "Supermarkets and Grocery"
anzsic_codes: ANZSIC code prefixes, e.g. "6419" (one class) or "64" (a whole subdivision)
keywords:     any text in the matter name, parties, consultation text or decision documents, e.g. "s87B"
